Evidence:
[1] The title track, "I Will Survive", was a cover of the chart topper for Gloria Gaynor in 1978.
[2] Based on the 1973 French play of the same name by Jean Poiret, it focuses on a gay couple: Georges, the manager of a Saint-Tropez nightclub featuring drag entertainment, and Albin, his romantic partner and star attraction, and the farcical adventures that ensue when Georges's son, Jean-Michel, brings home his fiancée's ultra-conservative parents to meet them.
[3] The title of the show is derived from the title of a song in the production, "I Will Survive", originally sung by Gloria Gaynor.
[4] The most notable song on the album was Gloria Gaynor's cover of "I Am What I Am" from the musical "La Cage Aux Folles".

Notes:
[bridge] The musical 'La Cage aux Folles' translates to 'The Cage of Mad Women' in English.
